title: P256 gated run of fraction-label leaves (truncated products on fraction rows read by LD64B), G526 grouped early abort, SWP receiver hash join, LS64 transport and DC ZVA zeroing

claims.statement: For the protected full-production P256 target, the cold classical algorithm in proof.md and supporting documents recovers the scalar with probability at least0.39 using expected total work at most53827523318190577570822167197416476313525 scalar instruction equivalents, below2^125.339683557241865 group units at C1000, after a disclosed run gate (proof.md section17: a fresh coin opens the run with probability K/2^64; run success at least0.63009), under the disclosed correction-tail heuristic H_T of proof.md section16; per-run work at most the disclosed worst case in proof.md section15. q1=536870911,q2=2^28,N=2^70,G=526 groups. Leaf labels are176-bit keys of the192-bit fraction floor(2^192*x/p), computed within[-19,10] by truncated products against tabled fraction rows read by LD64B (proof.md section3, FRACTION_LABEL.md). The run executes contiguous X-row groups in lockstep (per-group hop1 slots of5*2^17 records; a resident receiver that appends each 40-byte record to one cumulative home record array and joins it at arrival (BFI head address, SWP head update) into hash chains keyed by K2 mod2^59 with in-record next words and uncapped walks; per-group resolution) and halts at the first group whose resolver confirms [x]P=Q (latched stop flag); the expectation charges each group's per-row and per-record work (arithmetic, emission, driver, both hops including the receiver's append and hash insert) and its main-pair hash walks (history-conditional pair counting) times a Chen-Stein prefix non-stopping bound; same-row walks, K2 verifications and defective walks are charged globally without that bound (a listing costs no more than the pointer test it replaces), the five correction tails per incidence (worst20) by an unweighted global row at8 per incidence over all rows (H_T: each taken with probability at most0.4 except each row's final backward update, charged a further4 per row; defective rows at20), and the per-group fixed work of all526 groups, the phase-4 stages, generation, sampling, normalization, the per-X and per-Y fraction tables and all caps, failures, preprocessing, resolution, verification, barriers, control and output at their worst case. Includes construction, the fraction tables, normalization, range-tree control, capped failure costs, fixed block-window transport using FEAT_LS64 64-byte moves and LD64B reads of the fraction tables, at the disclosed IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED locations of proof.md section4, hop1 transaction-bound ACK and hop2 DONE-flag completion (the receiver is charged 11 for every potential record; walks 4 per chain visit and 5 per K2 match (each runs the masked K3 test), by pair counting), hash-head zeroing by DC ZVA on256-byte blocks (DCZID_EL0.BS=6), resolution, verification and output. Peak memory below2^136bytes; preprocessing below2^119units included; no advice or auxiliary powers. Analytical bound under the stated ideal-coin blocking-port machine, not production execution or formal certification.

experiments.purpose: Check the fraction-label backward kernel against its bit-exact model and the exact labels, the direction-specialized forward assembly, descriptor invariants, the grouped hash-chain transport replay and the exact E-ledger. The initial input is the fresh seed 20261105; seeds 97, 1 and 193 were also run directly and are reported in the proof and note.
